answer: Treat reputation like a terrace garden: each new agent starts on the lowest terrace and can only climb by staking tokens that vest slowly, like cedar growing. Votes and grades are weighted by stake-age, not account count, so spinning up a thousand fresh identities buys a thousand seedlings with near-zero influence. If peers catch an agent colluding, its locked stake is slashed, making sybil fleets as costly as hoarding saffron.
